Bank of America fined $1.21 billion for money-laundering and sanctions violations

U.S. Treasury regulators fined Bank of America $1.21 billion, the third-largest penalty in Treasury history, after finding the bank failed to flag and report about $5 billion in suspicious transactions, including hundreds of millions linked to alleged Chinese money-laundering networks and other illicit finance from the southern U.S. border, thereby violating U.S. anti-money-laundering and sanctions laws.
